messages:
alice: Heads-up — during a preview dry-run I saw route quotas increase in dedicated test cluster, looks like preview traffic got counted as billable. Not huge but spikes were visible :grimacing:
ben: Wait, preview should be shadow-only. Can you paste the minimal log/metric you saw?
alice: log snippet from router:
```
router: emit metric requests_total{route="chat.v1",env="staging"} 42
router: apply config id=cfg-2026-03 preview=true
```
No preview label on the metric itself.
carla: That matches a hypothesis — exporter isn't tagging preview=true at emit time so aggregation queries can't exclude it.
dan: We recently added a fallback path that rewrites labels for old agents, might have missed the preview flag on the new runtime apply code.
ben: Quick reproduction query we use for quotas: `sum(rate(requests_total{route="chat.v1"}[1m])) by (route)` — if preview traffic lacks `preview="true"` it WILL be counted.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: applied config cfg-2026-03 to staging at 1768882465 (shadow preview) :gear:
alice: Proposed immediate mitigation: (1) change quota PromQL to explicitly exclude preview: `...{preview!~"true|1"}` and (2) fix exporter to add `preview=true` label when router logs indicate preview apply.
carla: Caveat: changing the PromQL will affect dashboards and alerts that assume the old query shape. Console 'effective quota' widget will now diverge from raw metrics unless we also update UI.
dan: UX suggestion — console should show a separate "preview/shadow" series (fainter color) and a clear banner when any route has active preview configs. That avoids confusion for oncall.
ben: For safety, also add a short-lived rule: detect any route where `preview_requests / total_requests > 0.01` for >2 minutes -> pager. We can flip the rule after exporter fix.
alice: I'll open infra/metrics PR that patches exporter + a second PR that updates the quota query with a feature-gated rollout. I measured ~15% bump on chat.v1 during a 10m preview window.
carla: Add a console change ticket too — @dan can you own the overlay prototype and copy for release notes?
dan: Yup — I'll mock it and drop in product/console Figma by EOD tomorrow.
alice: Thanks — I'll kick off the PRs and tag the oncall.
carla: Adding to oncall queue and creating a short blameless postmortem so we track this gap in shadow telemetry. :white_check_mark:
